core_obligations: Present the strata (proof lines 778-781): write each T_i as a finite union of intersections of a quasi-compact open with the complement of a quasi-compact open.
Present the opens by basic opens (proof lines 781-785): write those quasi-compact opens as finite unions of basic opens D(f), producing finite families of elements f_{i,j,k} and g_{i,j,l}.

Conclude (proof lines 785-786): let E be the union of all those elements; the stratification attached to E has as its strata the labelled pieces given by the vanishing pattern of the elements of E, and each such piece is contained in a unique T_i, so the stratification refines the given one.
proof_roadmap: Write the constructible strata through quasi-compact opens and their complements.
Replace the quasi-compact opens by finitely many basic opens and collect the corresponding elements.
Observe that the vanishing-pattern stratification refines the original one.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a finite stratification of the spectrum of a ring by constructible subsets there is a finite set of elements whose associated vanishing-pattern stratification refines it (statement lines 770-776). The proof (proof lines 778-787) writes the strata through quasi-compact opens and their complements, replaces the quasi-compact opens by finitely many basic opens, and reads off the refinement from the vanishing patterns. H2: a three-step explicit construction with three inputs, written out in full.
